newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 4.97 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 4.97 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 4.97 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.

This compares with six-month HIBOR of 5.75000 percent at 0330 GMT and the average accepted yield of 5.06 percent at the pervious tender on October 22. Bids for the HK$800 million issue was at HK$4.33 billion against pervious HK$3.27 billion.
The average accepted yield of 91-day bills was 4.92 percent, against three-month HIBOR of 5.56818 percent and the average accepted yield of 4.94 percent at the previous weekly tender.
Bids for the HK$1.50 billion issue was HK$8.24 billion vs HK$6.05 billion.
